event_data.context: Urgent shared defect discovered while reviewing the Tiber app-server spike. final_review.assess_risk succeeds, but final_review.plan repeatedly fails with review_event_command_failed / append_events and creates no resumable session. The failure affects other projects and blocks authoritative multi-agent review. Preserve the stashed Tiber spike; reproduce at the Git event-store boundary, fix the shared cause, prove restart and cross-repository behavior, publish the plugin repair, then restore the spike.
event_data.summary: Restore reliable Git-backed EventCore persistence for advisory final-review orchestration so plan and later review transitions append successfully across repositories.
event_data.title: Fix shared review EventCore append failures
